import os

code='''def transform(grid):
    # The colored crossings mark the corners of rectangular cells.
    # Collapse each interval between successive full marker lines to its corner color.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v!=bg for v in row)>1]
    cs=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if sum(grid[i][j]!=bg for i in range(len(grid)))>1]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c,d in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            vals=[grid[a][c],grid[a][d],grid[b][c],grid[b][d]]
            non=[v for v in vals if v!=bg]
            row.append(non[0] if non and len(set(non))==1 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
grid=[[5,0]+[5]*25+[0]]
